csv_project_name: Dev Scv for Pad D Waterfront Hotel Development Opportunity
csv_scope_of_work: The Port of Anacortes invites qualified development teams to submit proposals for the ground lease and development of a hotel on Pad D, a premier waterfront site within the Port's Cap Sante Marina district. The Port is seeking a developer with demonstrated experience in hospitality and mixed-use development to design, finance, construct, and operate a high-quality hotel that enhances the waterfront experience and supports the region's growing visitor economy. The Port of Anacortes is seeking a highly qualified developer to deliver a destination hotel project that reflects the character of Anacortes while elevating the waterfront as a year-round economic and recreational hub. This solicitation represents a rare opportunity to secure a long-term ground lease on a highly visible waterfront parcel and to create a hotel development that serves as an anchor for waterfront activity. The selected development partner will enter into a long-term ground lease (anticipated 50 80 years) and will be responsible for full project delivery, including financing, entitlements, design, construction, and operations. Development obligations will include construction of the full 51,177sf parcel (shown as Development Area D and E on the adjacent conceptual site map), including the dedicated parking lot, coordinating with the Port on connections to the surrounding public areas, and installing a public benefit and/or art element at the corner of 9th Street and Q Avenue that serves the entrance to the new waterfront community, grounded by the hotel. Utility connections are in existence.

title: Development Services for Pad D Waterfront Hotel Development Opportunity
short_description: Developer sought for a waterfront destination hotel on a long-term ground lease parcel.
project_scope: Development of a waterfront hotel on the Port of Anacortes Pad D site within the Cap Sante Marina district. The selected team will design, finance, construct, and operate the project under an anticipated 50-80 year ground lease. The development area comprises the full 51,177 sq ft parcel identified as Development Area D and E, including a dedicated parking lot, coordination of connections to surrounding public areas, and installation of a public benefit and/or art element at the corner of 9th Street and Q Avenue. Utility connections already exist.
services: Design-build/developer services including development, financing, entitlements, architectural and engineering design, construction, and hotel operations.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project rather than a bridge or special long-span structure.
- Hotel development could involve architectural and structural input, but no structural complexity, span, or innovative engineering features are described.
- Procurement is primarily for a developer/design-build team, not specifically for structural engineering services.
- Waterfront location may offer some design interest, but the notice provides no evidence of demanding load-bearing structures.
- Strategically possible only as part of a broader development team, therefore moderate-low relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Available scope information: waterfront hotel development on a 51,177 sq ft parcel with parking, public-area connections, and a public benefit/art element; utilities already exist. A realistic cost estimate is not possible from the provided information because hotel size, number of rooms, height, quality level, and program are not specified.
fee_explanation: No engineering fee information is stated. Since the solicitation is for a developer/design-build team and no project budget, building size, or engineering scope breakdown is provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified development team with demonstrated experience in hospitality and mixed-use development.
